d: A Medley based tribute to the legendary Ustad Zakir Hussain with diverse pieces of music / percussion featuring his performances with Classical Dance performance, solo and duet percussion performances and accompaniment with classical instrumental and vocal / folk music. His collaborators feature his father and Guru, Ustad Alla Rakha, Santoor legend Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and Sarangi Maestro Ustad Sultan Khan.
